backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for each frontend file used in the PMO Impact Pitch app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining light/dark theme color tokens and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component assembling navigation, all content sections, footer, and smooth scrolling.
frontend/src/components/ReferenceNotes.t: Collapsible section displaying two reference images with a card-based layout.
frontend/src/components/SectionNav.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with scroll tracking, smooth scrolling, and mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutMe: About Me section showing PMO experience, strengths, and core expertise via cards and badges.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroExe: Hero section with background image, headline, stats, and scroll-triggered CTA buttons for navigating to success and about sections.
frontend/src/components/sections/ImpactS: Displays impact analysis with before/after cards, summary stats, and a grid generated from impact statements.
frontend/src/components/sections/Roadmap: Renders a 90‑day execution roadmap with phases, tasks, and core principles sourced from roadmap content.
frontend/src/components/sections/Success: Tabbed module showing success criteria, STAR stories, and navigation triggers to Impact and Roadmap sections.
frontend/src/content/pitchContent.ts: Defines success criteria, stories, and supporting pitch content used across multiple sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, exposing identity, login, logout, and status helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file exporting nothing because the backend has no query methods.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers, CSS variables for light and dark themes, and global typography and layout utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, themes, plugins, animations, and container settings using CSS variables.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, feature definitions, and image needs for build planning.
